crossRefs.note: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
After a while, the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.
Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the springs of water, and to all the brooks. Perhaps we may find…

translations.web: Yes, the animals of the field pant to you, for the water brooks have dried up, And the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
translations.bsb: Even the beasts of the field pant for You, for the streams of water have dried up, and fire has consumed the open pastures.
translations.kjv: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
translations.asv: Yea, the beasts of the field pant unto thee; for the water brooks are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
